The statement is a conjunction of independent closure principles. A nonempty absolutely convex hull contains \(0\) by balancedness. Lower bounds multiply because multiplication is monotone in each variable. Finally, continuity lets the convexity and balancedness relations pass to limits, so the closure of an absolutely convex set remains absolutely convex. Thus both sides of the displayed equivalence are universally true; the equivalence reflects no deeper connection between them.
